title: The Grunion Run, 2019 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The morning after: the nine lanterns on the shelf and one more thing beside them — the girl's notebook, left, open to 'both.' Gully goes to close it and doesn't. The high shelf takes the notebook. She'll want it back. She won't.

panels.composition: The shack. Nine lanterns on the shelf. On the counter, the GIRL's notebook, open. GULLY. The PUP.

panels.composition: The page: 'the fish moved / the people did / both' with two underlines.
